videos.caption: On October 25, 2026, Algeria’s parliament unanimously approved sending army units to Niger, the first deployment of Algerian troops abroad since the 1973 war, when Algeria sent forces to support Egypt. The soldiers are expected to be stationed in Madama, in northern Niger near the Libyan border, at a former French military base. According to Algerian media, their mission could include protecting energy facilities and Sonatrach investments in the region. This comes after Algeria sent four Su-30 fighter jets to Niamey in August, following a failed mutiny. A major shift for an army that has stayed inside its borders for over 50 years. 🌍 #Algeria #algérie #Sahel #Africa #🇩🇿
